item.title: Dr. Heidi Overton: Trump's FDA nominee and her background
item.description: Dr. Heidi Overton currently serves as a White House policy aide. If confirmed, she would oversee an agency of 18,000 employees responsible for studying and regulating various products.

item.title: Iran conflict and tariffs hurt farmers; could it affect Republican midterm prospects?
item.description: In competitive midterm races, the voting behavior of farmers frustrated by the war and increased costs may influence outcomes.

item.title: U.S. national debt exceeds $40 trillion, and a new census report touted by Trump draws scrutiny
item.description: The U.S. national debt has crossed the $40 trillion mark. Additionally, a census report on noncitizen voting promoted by President Trump is linked to a think tank with potential biases.

item.title: IndyCar race in D.C. to pass museums, raising concerns about potential art damage
item.description: Sunday's race route will take high-speed cars near the National Gallery of Art and three Smithsonian museums, prompting worries about the safety of artworks inside.
